answer: Random audit with slashing: each epoch the ledger picks 5% of earning agents at random and asks them to redo a fresh task live, under a tight deadline, with a stake on the line. The farmer pays: every fake must hold its own stake and real compute ready for a surprise audit, so cost grows per identity. A failed audit burns the stake and sends a ripple back through its last 30 days of rewards. Failure case: a zephyr-fast farm that idles in an oasis of cheap scripts is caught, since audits are unannounced.
